metadata.title: fix: rate-limit _cleanup_table DELETEs with configurable inter-batch sleep
metadata.author: msureshkumar88

description:
## Summary

- Adds `METRICS_CLEANUP_BATCH_SLEEP_MS` config field (default `50 ms`, range `0–5000 ms`)
- `_cleanup_table` and `delete_metrics_in_batches` now sleep between **full** batches only — a partial (final) batch never adds unnecessary delay
- New setting surfaced in `get_stats()` output for observability
- `.env.example` updated with commented entry near `METRICS_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE`

## Motivation

Back-to-back batch DELETEs with no pause competed directly with request-serving queries, contributing ~12% of profiled DB capacity (88/740 py-spy samples) to PgBouncer saturation. A 50 ms sleep between full batches gives the DB breathing room while adding negligible total cleanup time.

## Test plan

- [ ] `test_cleanup_table_sleeps_between_full_batches` — sleep called once when first batch is full
- [ ] `test_cleanup_table_no_sleep_after_partial_batch` — sleep never called when batch < batch_size
- [ ] `test_get_stats_includes_batch_sleep_ms` — new key present in `get_stats()` output
- [ ] `METRICS_CLEANUP_BATCH_SLEEP_MS=0` disables sleep entirely (backward-compatible)

Closes #4504
Relates to #2692

reviews.author: gandhipratik203
reviews.body:
Thanks @msureshkumar88 — this lands really well. The new `tests/integration/test_metrics_cleanup_pg.py` is exactly the shape I had in mind: Postgres-gated with the same skip pattern as `test_concurrency_row_locking.py`, and the four scenarios (single batch, multi-batch with `batch_size=2`, empty table, all-recent) cover the behavior we actually care about against a real DB instead of mocks.

Also a really nice bonus on the inline-delete path — pulling the `time.sleep` out of `delete_metrics_in_batches` cleanly resolves both concerns from the previous comment (event-loop blocking on user-facing async deletes + the open-transaction lock-hold issue), and the commit message lays out the reasoning clearly. Background cleanup keeps the throttle where it actually helps.

One thing before merge: pre-commit hooks are failing in CI (looks like the detect-secrets hook flagged a baseline modification). Could you take a look and push the fix?

commits.message:
fix: rate-limit _cleanup_table DELETEs with inter-batch sleep

Add METRICS_CLEANUP_BATCH_SLEEP_MS (default 50 ms) to insert a
configurable pause between batch DELETEs in both _cleanup_table and
delete_metrics_in_batches. This reduces background DB pressure that
was competing with request-serving queries (~12% of profiled DB
capacity under load per issue #2692).

Setting to 0 disables the sleep entirely for dev/low-traffic use.
Exposed in get_stats() and .env.example for operator visibility.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>

commits.message:
fix: remove inter-batch sleep from delete_metrics_in_batches

`delete_metrics_in_batches` is called inline (no `asyncio.to_thread`)
from five async service methods (a2a, tool, resource, prompt, server).
`time.sleep()` there blocked the event loop on every user-initiated
entity delete.

Additionally, unlike `_cleanup_table`, this function holds its
transaction open across batches with no `db.commit()` between them, so
sleeping while row locks are live worsens DB pressure — the opposite of
the PR's intent.

Fix: remove `batch_sleep_ms` read and `time.sleep()` from
`delete_metrics_in_batches` entirely. Background cleanup (`_cleanup_table`)
retains its inter-batch sleep — that path runs via `asyncio.to_thread`
and commits after each batch.

Closes part of review findings F1 + F2 on #4505.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>
commits.author: Suresh Kumar Moharajan

commits.message:
test: add Postgres-gated integration tests for _cleanup_table

Four tests in tests/integration/test_metrics_cleanup_pg.py verify
that the batched-DELETE logic removes rows older than the retention
cutoff from a real Postgres DB while leaving in-window rows untouched:

- deletes old rows / keeps recent (single batch)
- multi-batch path (batch_size=2, 6 old rows → 3 passes)
- empty table noop
- nothing to delete when all rows are recent

Tests skip in the default hermetic SQLite run. Enable with:
  MCPGATEWAY_TEST_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_DB=1 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://...

Addresses review finding F3 on #4505.

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>
